title: Fix installer verification when provider credentials are present
description: The v0.1.1 PowerShell installer successfully installed and verified checksum on native Windows, but printed 'WARNING: Verification did not match expected output; try: eshyra' when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN was already present in the environment. install.ps1 currently runs the wrapper with no args and only treats output containing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as verified. With credentials present, the no-arg CLI prints the normal banner ('Eshyra — core v0.1.1 ...') instead, so verification falsely warns. Update install.ps1 (and install.sh if it has the same assumption) to accept stable successful startup/banner output as well as no-config setup guidance. Do not invoke a model call during installer verification. Add tests for verification output with and without provider credentials.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 124c3a7: POSIX and PowerShell installers accept either no-config setup guidance or the stable startup banner, while verification remains a bare non-gameplay invocation. Full worktree verification and focused installer/CLI tests pass.
